main.description: A light-meter reading containing an observed photometric quantity, observation geometry, instrument, and optional exposure solution. It supports phone meters, handheld ambient or spot meters, and imported flash-meter readings. geometry, lightKind, and createdAt are required; other fields may be added afterward. ev100, illuminance, and luminance store measurements, while exposure stores the displayed solution and its compensation, filters, and reciprocity adjustment.

meter.description: Optional app.graycard.instance.meter that took the reading (a handheld meter, or a phone acting as one).

calibration.description: Optional app.graycard.meter.calibration profile applied to this reading.

ev100.description: Exposure value normalized to ISO 100 (unit 'EV'). The canonical photometric result for exposure purposes.

illuminance.description: Incident illuminance (unit 'lx'; clients may display fc). Canonical for incident readings.

luminance.description: Reflected luminance (unit 'cd/m2'; clients may display fL). Canonical for reflected/spot readings.

calibrationConstant.description: The ISO 2720 constant used to relate photometry to exposure for this reading: K in cd·s/(m²·ISO) for reflected (commonly 12.5), C in lx·s/ISO for incident (commonly 250 flat / 330 dome). Recorded so readings from differently-calibrated instruments remain comparable.

nominalSpotAngle.description: Advertised acceptance angle of the spot optics in degrees (1 for a true spot meter).

achievedSpotAngle.description: Acceptance angle actually integrated for this reading, in degrees. For phone spot metering this is the optics-limited value and may exceed the requested angle.

spotPoint.description: Where in the preview frame the spot patch was centered, normalized [0,1] × 1e6 (see app.graycard.defs#scaledInteger convention used by scene regions).

previewPhoto.description: Optional photo record (e.g. social.grain.photo) of the metered scene/preview frame the spotPoint refers to.

iso.description: Sensitivity the exposure solution is stated at (arithmetic ISO). Fractional ISO below 1 (e.g. 0.8) may be expressed via exposureCompensation instead.

aperture.description: Solved or held f-number as displayed, e.g. '5.6', '1.0', '90' (matches instance.exposure dial convention).

shutterSeconds.description: Solved or held exposure time in seconds (unit 's'). Long exposures store the reciprocity-corrected value here when reciprocity is applied; see reciprocity.

exposureCompensation.description: Compensation applied to the solution in EV, e.g. '-0.5', '+1'.

frameRate.description: Cine mode: frame rate in fps.

shutterAngle.description: Cine mode: shutter angle in degrees (time = angle / (360 × fps)).

filter.description: Optional app.graycard.instance.filter whose factor is included in the solution.

filterCompensation.description: Total filter/ND compensation folded into the solution, in stops.

reciprocity.description: Reciprocity-failure correction applied to the solution.

flash.description: Flash-metering details (typically imported from a dedicated flash meter).

flashPercent.description: Flash contribution to total exposure, percent (the flash/ambient analysis figure).

cumulativeCount.description: Number of pops accumulated for a multiple-flash reading.

duration.description: Measured flash duration in seconds at the stated threshold.

durationThreshold.description: Duration threshold convention, e.g. 't0.5', 't0.1' (fraction of peak intensity the duration is measured at).

seriesId.description: Groups readings taken as one workflow set (spot memory bank, averaging session, contrast evaluation). Members share the id.

averagedFrom.description: For role 'average': the member readings combined into this value.

targetZone.description: Zone System placement of the metered area (0–X). The exposure solution reflects this placement.

placementOffset.description: Stops offset from meter-indicated middle gray applied by placement (targetZone − 5, or a free offset), in stops.

colorTemperature.description: Correlated color temperature in kelvin, when the instrument measures it.

flags.description: Instrument caveats attached to the value, e.g. 'out-of-range-low', 'out-of-range-high', 'flare-risk', 'uncalibrated', 'approximate-incident'.

subject.description: What was metered, e.g. 'north rock face, shadow under overhang'.

exposure.description: Optional app.graycard.instance.exposure this reading informed. The exposure record's meterReadings array is the canonical aggregation; this back-reference is a convenience.

shoot.description: Optional app.graycard.session.capture this reading belongs to.
